name: Kootu Bhaaki
tagline: Private offline expense splitter and debt simplifier
features: 100% offline without accounts or phone numbers
description:
Kootu Bhaaki (കൂട്ടു ബാക്കി) is a lightweight, respectful group expense manager built for trips, roommates, and events.

With zero accounts, offline Bluetooth/QR syncing, and an exact minimal debt settlement graph algorithm, splitting bills is frictionless.

screenshots.caption: Minimal debt settlement summary and shareable breakdown

shortDescription: Split expenses and calculate minimal cash transfers with zero sign-ups and zero data leaves your phone.

description:
JayaDoc is a personal document scanner and markdown knowledge base engineered for students, researchers, and engineers.

Enjoy pure black AMOLED themes, bi-directional document linking, camera document boundary auto-detection, and zero cloud dependency.

screenshots.caption: Clean distraction-free markdown editor with live preview

shortDescription: Offline-first document organizer with instant OCR scanning, LaTeX math rendering, and encrypted local storage.

name: Aura Video Player
tagline: High-performance AMOLED video player with hardware decoding
features: Gesture control for seek, brightness, and audio volume
Background audio playback and PiP window
No ads, no trackers, 100% offline playback
whatsNew: Added HDR10+ tone mapping and improved gesture scrub precision.
description:
Aura Video Player is an ultra-optimized media player for Android designed to showcase OLED and AMOLED displays at maximum fidelity.

Featuring zero advertising, sub-pixel picture-in-picture, custom gesture brightness and volume sliders, subtitle synchronization, and multi-format audio track pass-through.

permissions.name: Read Storage Media
permissions.description: Required to scan and play video files stored on device.

screenshots.caption: True pitch-black AMOLED interface during playback
Intuitive swipe gestures for brightness, volume, and seeking

previousVersions.whatsNew: Initial release of Aura Video Player.
